content.thinking: So far I've found invoice 742 off by 45.00 against its journal, invoices 801/802 duplicating 557/28, and a 0.01 discrepancy on payment 52 (likely a minor distractor). Next I'll check payment journals against payments, verify whether the duplicate invoices have their own journals, and review the dates on invoice journals.

input.sql: select h."JRNL_NO",h."SRC_REF",h."MEMO",h."POST_DT",h."PRD_ID",(select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") amt, p."PAY_AMT",p."PAY_DT" from "GLJRNH" h left join "APPAYM" p on 'PAY-'||p."PAY_ID"=trim(h."SRC_REF") where h."SRC_CD"='AP' and h."SRC_REF" like 'PAY-%' and (p."PAY_ID" is null or p."PAY_AMT"<>(select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") or p."PAY_DT"<>h."POST_DT")
select count(*) from "APPAYM" p where not exists (select 1 from "GLJRNH" h where trim(h."SRC_REF")='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID")

select i."INV_ID",i."JRNL_NO",i."INV_DT",h."POST_DT",h."PRD_ID",p."STRT_DT",p."END_DT" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where i."INV_DT"<>h."POST_DT" or i."INV_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT"
select "JRNL_NO",count(*),array_agg("INV_ID") from "APINVH" group by 1 having count(*)>1
